purpose: Per-validation_id instruction map for Gemini validation. The engine must join each instruction record with its matching variant record from validation_variants_data_v1.json.

required_actions.instruction: Use this instruction record by validation_id together with the matching variant record from validation_variants_data_v1.json. Never validate from this file alone.

Verify the vehicle identity for Israeli market relevance. Do not change make/model/year/engine/transmission/fuel_type/drivetrain/trim unless the evidence is strong; otherwise keep value and set requires_manual_review=true.
Verify the exact marketed model name and trim/display name used in Israel. Fill Hebrew/local brand name only when reasonably supported. Do not invent importer-only trim names.
Complete every missing/unknown standard field when reliable evidence exists. If a field cannot be verified, return null for that field and include it in unresolved_fields with a manual_review reason.
Compare against all records in the same duplicate group after both files are loaded. Decide whether to merge, keep separate, or flag manual_review. Preserve evidence in duplicate_resolution.
Only fill rebadged_as when the model is clearly known as a rebadge. Otherwise return null/empty and do not treat it as a defect.
Return only valid JSON matching the validation schema. Include confidence, evidence_summary, fields_changed, fields_completed, unresolved_fields, requires_manual_review, and final_decision.
